svg.title: Multitenancy
svg.desc: Tenants A, B, and C share one app and one database whose rows are tagged with a tenant ID. Tenant C starts a huge report, the database CPU hits 100 percent, and pages for A and B take 12 seconds. Tenant C then gets a dedicated database, CPU drops, and A and B are fast again.
svg.text: One huge tenant slows everyone on the shared database, until it moves out.
